The path has four points: (52,72), (3,95), (53,30), and back to (52,72).  
It draws a closed shape with four vertices, so it is a quadrilateral.  
Among the options, "kite" is a type of quadrilateral.  
Checking the coordinates:  
- Sides: between (52,72) and (3,95) is one edge,  
  (3,95) to (53,30) is another,  
  (53,30) to (52,72) is the third,  
  and the path closes with (52,72) to (52,72)? Wait — the last segment is from (53,30) to (52,72), then the path ends at (52,72) but the start was (52,72). Actually, the first and last points are the same, so it's a triangle: only three distinct vertices: (52,72), (3,95), (53,30).  
Thus it's a triangle, not a kite.  

Final answer: (J)
